title: Card 6: tweet Cassandra me, user_id se machines me baanto. Arpan ke saare tweet ek machine pe, naya sabse upar

boxes.title: Machine (Arpan)
lines: Arpan ke saare tweet, naya upar

callouts.green: Har tweet pe har index disk pe dhoondh ke badalna, dheema. Aur join / transaction yahan chahiye hi nahi
Bojh barabar bat-ta, par Arpan ki profile ke liye saari machine poochni padti

callouts.red: Famous aadmi ki machine garam ho gayi
callouts.green: Theek hai: garam tweet waise bhi alag RAM cache (card 4) se jaate
Har cheez ki 3 copy. 2 me likho, 2 se padho, naya tweet mil hi jaata

callouts.red: Kisi ke itne tweet ki ek machine bhar rahi
callouts.green: Key me mahina jodo (user_id, mahina): har mahine ka alag tukda

callouts.red: Cassandra me likhna tez kyun? Wo sirf aakhir me jodta (log), purana badalta nahi. RAM bhari to nayi file disk pe.
callouts.green: Files bahut ho gayi to padhna dheema: peeche milao (compaction), aur Bloom filter batata kis file me dekhna

kyun: Ek DB na itna rakh sakta na itna likh sakta. Profile user_id se padhte hain, to user_id se hi baanto: Arpan ke saare tweet ek machine pe. Cassandra sirf aakhir me jodta, isliye likhna tez
peeche: card 5 me inbox me sirf aakhri 800, soye user ka inbox mita
ab: DB alert: har second 5,000 tweet, 5 saal me 0.5 PB
agla: ab data US me, par Arpan Bangalore me (card 7)
